title: Extension Committee Standard: Filing Lead Allowance on a Re-Filed Extension Request in Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases
content:
**Filing lead.** For a further extension request re-filed on a Cedarline Summit loan's Maturity and Due-and-Payable Cases case, the filing lead is the calendar days from the day the request being replaced was received to the current resolution deadline. The request being replaced is the most recently received request on the case still awaiting a decision when the new one is filed.

**Rule.**

- Where the filing lead is less than the plan's extension lead days (15 calendar days under every plan), 5 calendar days are added to the requested length. This covers the processing a late request leaves no room for, and it includes a request received after the current resolution deadline.
- Where it is at least 15 and no more than 30, 2 calendar days are added to it.
- Where it is more than 30, nothing is added.

| Filing lead of the replaced request | Days added to the requested length |
|---|---|
| received after the deadline | 5 |
| 0 to 14 days | 5 |
| 15 to 30 days | 2 |
| 31 days or more | 0 |

## Both sides (hypothetical; resolution deadline 31 May)

| Replaced request received | Filing lead | Days added |
|---|---|---|
| 17 May | 14 | 5 |
| 16 May | 15 | 2 |
| 1 May | 30 | 2 |
| 30 April | 31 | 0 |
| 2 June | received after the deadline | 5 |
